$comment: Strict Structured Outputs schema for ONE model read of ONE register page (F-03.R4). Shipped verbatim as apps/api/app/pipeline/prompts/read_schema_v1.json. Strict-mode subset only: every property required, additionalProperties false, nullable via type arrays, no if/then/allOf/pattern/bounds. Ranges and cell invariants are enforced by the PageRead model after parsing (data-model.md Section 1).

month_written.description: Month exactly as handwritten in the header, e.g. 'Sep 2026'

page_no_written.description: Page number exactly as handwritten, e.g. '2'

table_top.description: Top edge of printed data row slot 1 as a fraction of image height (0 to 1); excludes the header row

table_bottom.description: Bottom edge of printed data row slot 16 as a fraction of image height (0 to 1)

blank_row_slots.description: Number of printed row slots with nothing written in them

rows.description: One entry per row slot that has anything written in it, in slot order

row_index.description: Printed slot number counted from 1 at the top

value.description: Exactly what is written; null when blank, ILLEGIBLE or UNCLEAR

struck.description: Struck-through value; only when status is CORRECTED

candidates.description: Possible readings; only when status is UNCLEAR

note.description: What you see, e.g. 'ink blot', 'overwritten', 'leading 2 visible, rest covered'
